intro_text:
Managed the end-to-end digital presence for an Italian chef across Instagram and TikTok. My goal was to elevate the channel from standard recipe videos to a dynamic, engaging, and multi-format culinary brand.

Project: Culinary Content Strategy & Production
Client: @potuschef (Italian Chef) - Instagram & TikTok
Role: Social Media Strategist & Lead Content Creator
technical_text:
Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
Social Media Strategy & Format Development: Revamped the content strategy by conceptualizing and launching successful new video series. This included "Strangers in the Kitchen" (an interactive, entertainment-driven format) and a structured series of "Basic & Advanced Cooking Techniques" to build authority and educate the audience.

End-to-End Production: Handled all on-set videography, directing the shoots to capture the authentic, fast-paced environment of a professional kitchen.

Video Editing: Edited short-form, high-retention video content (Reels/TikToks) optimized for current social media trends, pacing, and audio.

Delivery: Managed the final asset delivery and content pipeline, ensuring a consistent and high-quality posting schedule.
